summary: KiCom can expand to an operator-authorized target webspace using transient FTP/FTPS bootstrap access, create a child cell under kicom/, enroll it into a signed parent/child federation, and drive it through parent cron forwarding.
credential_policy: Temporary FTP/FTPS credentials are transient and must never be persisted in Git, KiCom project memory, logs, diagnostics, release notes or child configuration.
cron_model: Parent/root cron sends signed FEDERATION_TICK messages over HTTPS to active child cells.
recursive_expansion: Explicit capability only; not automatically inherited.
preservation_rule: Preserve and archive goal/design history rather than destructively deleting it unless explicitly requested.
